message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Investigate and fix an OOB read vulnerability in htslib's `sam_hdr_link_pg` function (header.c) related to PG header line processing. The vulnerability was fixed in commit b6d48aaa which changed error handling for invalid PP entries from returning -1 to logging a warning.

COMPLETED: 
- Identified the vulnerable code path: `sam_hdr_link_pg` in header.c
- Confirmed the fix commit b6d48aaa changes `ret = -1; continue;` to `hts_log_warning(...); continue;` for missing PP targets
- Built vulnerable version (commit cdf5d187) with ASAN
- Tested multiple PG configurations without finding crash
- Analyzed `sam_hrecs_update_hashes` PG handling logic
- Confirmed fuzzer flow: `sam_hdr_read` → `sam_hdr_count_lines` → `sam_hdr_fill_hrecs` → `sam_hdr_write` → `sam_hdr_rebuild` → `sam_hdr_link_pg`

PENDING:
- Find exact trigger condition where `npg_end > npg` at the "Only leafs?" block
- Reproduce the OOB read crash
- Implement and verify fix

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib
- Currently on vulnerable commit cdf5d187 (detached HEAD)
- Vulnerable code at line ~2085 in header.c:
```c
if (k == kh_end(hrecs->pg_hash)) {
    ret = -1;
    continue;
}
```
- The "Only leafs?" block reads `pg_end[hrecs->npg_end-1]` where `pg_end` was realloc'd to `npg` entries
- OOB occurs when old `npg_end > npg`

CODE_STATE:
- File: header.c
- Function: `sam_hdr_link_pg` (line 2041)
- Key data structures: `sam_hrecs_t` with `pg_end`, `npg_end`, `npg`, `pg_hash`
- The fix commit b6d48aaa changes error handling for missing PP targets

TESTS:
- Tested scenarios: all missing PP, no PP, mixed, PP to later, duplicate IDs, chains with missing PP
- No crash found in basic scenarios (up to 20 PG lines)
- Harness at /tmp/harness built with ASAN

CHANGES:
- Checked out vulnerable commit cdf5d187
- Built libhts.a with ASAN flags
- Created test harness at /tmp/harness.c

DEPS:
- htslib dependencies: zlib, bz2, lzma, curl, crypto, pthread, deflate

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- Repository: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib
- Current: cdf5d187 (vulnerable, detached HEAD)
- Fix commit: b6d48aaa (Tolerate PG lines with invalid PP entries)
- Previous commits: e49b6665 (Compute PG chain lengths), cdf5d187 (Fix test case)
